summary: The agent successfully implements a regression pipeline with reasonable feature engineering, categorical encoding, and 5-fold cross validation. However, it fails to tune its ensemble weights, applying a naive 50-50 split (FM12). Additionally, it computes frequency encoding globally before CV splitting (causing mild target leakage across folds) and fails to report any validation scores during training.
